From the photographic archive

Elvira Graham

20 Clapham High Street, London SW4 7UR

Knitwear shop

A moment on the high street

What the photograph records

The former Elvira Graham knitwear shop at 20 Clapham High Street, London SW4 7UR, on the right of this photograph taken on 3 April 2026. Its blue fascia and shuttered frontage stand beside the former Jeannette Fashions haberdashery at number 22, on the left.

Photographed
3 April 2026
Recorded state
Vacant when photographed
Business type
Knitwear shop

This record describes the premises on the photograph date. Later changes may not yet be included in the archive.

A few dates in the story

  1. 2020 Published source

    Maurice Dorfman dies

    Jim Grover's photo-essay records Maurice Dorfman's death in 2020 and the history of neighbouring Jeannette Fashions. The project owner states that Dorfman owned both shops and that Elvira continued here while inheritance arrangements were resolved.

    Jim Grover's Behind the Shop Facade photo-essay ↗
  2. December 2025 Reported · unconfirmed

    Elvira Graham leaves these premises

    The project owner reports that Elvira left in December 2025. The exact final trading day is unknown; this does not establish whether the designer continued elsewhere.

  3. 3 April 2026 Documented

    Elvira Graham: closed by this date

    The project photographer confirms Elvira Graham had ceased trading at this address by the time this photograph was taken. The exact closing date is unknown.

  4. 29 October 2026 Reported · unconfirmed

    Building works reported

    The project owner reports major building works at numbers 20 and 22. This is the report date, not an established start date for the works or evidence of a completed new shop configuration.
